description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. To view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions, see [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html).

description.zh: 资源的标签键。取值范围：最大长度为64个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?
description.en: The tag key of the resource. The value can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, and special characters such as @ \_ - = + ; : , < . > / ?
